solutions.title: Length prefix
solutions.strategy: Prefix each string with its decimal length and a separator that is read only after the length.

timeComplexity.explanation: Encoding and decoding scan the total character count once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The encoded string and decoded list store the full payload.

solutions.title: Indexed length prefix
solutions.strategy: Use the same format with explicit index movement to keep decode iterative and allocation-light.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each encoded character belongs to exactly one parse step.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Output storage is linear in payload size.
